name: Backend Engineer Screening
steps: Open the ATS and filter for Backend Engineer role with status New.
For each applicant, open their profile and read the resume file name to determine Python experience years and referral status.
Apply rules to determine if the applicant is rejected or booked for an interview.
If rejected, send rejection email after owner approval.
If booked, update ATS status to Interview and send invite email.

fields.name: python_years
fields.description: Years of Python experience extracted from resume

interview_invite.subject: Interview Invitation - Backend Engineer
interview_invite.body: Hi {name}, we would like to invite you for a 30 minute call. You are scheduled for {slot}.

rejection_notice.subject: Update on your application
rejection_notice.body: Hi {name}, thank you for your interest in the Backend Engineer role. We have decided not to move forward at this time.

notes: The resume file name is the only source for Python experience; if the file name does not contain this information, the AI cannot determine the experience level.
The prompt does not specify how to identify a referral; assuming this is a field in the ATS profile.
